'''Jaako''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] within the [[Tonvarr pirates]], a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that learned of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum's]] location while it was being visited by the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Gray Secant]]''. Raiding parties under Jaako's leadership looted powerful Gree technology from the planet, arming themselves with Gree weapons and armor until Jaako was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaako was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.7: Return of the Gree, as the final enemy in one of the Daily missions during the Relics of the Gree World Event&mdash;"Unexpected Variables" and "External Variables" for Republic and Imperial players respectively..<ref name="TOR" />
